- **Node-level idea:** Add a single per-ear "floor/wall" early reflection cluster via a short `DelayNode` + `BiquadFilterNode` (lowpass) + `GainNode` feeding back into the existing dry sum (parallel send, not inserted in series), rather than adding more discrete taps — effectively a tiny 2-tap reflection "spread" (one longer, one shorter delay per ear) with a gentle high-shelf cut to simulate distance/back-of-room damping; this reinforces front/back cues without new node types.

- **Parameter ranges:** delay 15–35 ms (front reflection ~15–20 ms, "behind" reflection ~28–35 ms), gain -12 to -18 dB relative to direct path, lowpass cutoff 3–5 kHz (Q ~0.7), with the "behind" tap given an extra -3 dB and lower cutoff (~2.5–3 kHz) vs the "front" tap to differentiate front/back via spectral tilt rather than amplitude alone.

- Keep total added reflections ≤2 per ear (reuse existing 11/13 & 21/24 ms taps if possible by re-tuning gain/cutoff rather than adding fresh DelayNodes) to avoid doubling node count and preserve low CPU on iPhone 6-class hardware.

- Sum all reflection sends into the same stereo bus pre-ITD-panning so mono fold-down (L+R) still collapses coherently — avoid any per-ear-only phase inversion or all-pass tricks that would cancel in mono.

- **Failure mode to test:** comb filtering / hollow timbre when mono-summed — check L+R at 0/70° source angles for audible notches (sweep sine or pink noise, look for >6 dB dips in mono spectrum) caused by the new delay taps interfering with the existing 11–24 ms reflections; if present, nudge delay times apart (avoid exact multiples) or reduce reflection gain further.

- Secondary check: confirm `AudioBufferSourceNode` reconnection/rebuild (since only one track can be active) doesn't leak the added DelayNode/BiquadFilterNode graph across track switches — verify node teardown on stop to prevent gradual CPU/memory creep on iOS 12 Safari's WebKit AudioContext.
